purpose: Frozen multi-segment foot abstraction, plantar contact geometry, foot-segment inertia and the passive/active MTP contract.

decisions.value: per foot: hindfoot body, forefoot body welded/fixed to the hindfoot in V1 (separate geometry/inertia, no midtarsal DOF), toe/phalanx body, one sagittal MTP hinge; ankle hinge connects shank -> hindfoot
decisions.locator: system authority section 6; S02 three-segment model
decisions.notes: The old single rigid box foot is rejected.

decisions.value: a rigid arch / locked midfoot is a MATERIAL MODEL-FORM UNCERTAINTY, not harmless omission
decisions.notes: Rigid-foot assumptions can materially distort ankle ROM and quasi-stiffness.

value.requirement: final qualification must compare the locked-midfoot Plant against a plausible compliant/articulated-midfoot alternative (at least one bounded sagittal midtarsal DOF or equivalent compliant coupling with documented range/stiffness)

decisions.notes: If locking the midfoot materially changes these outputs, the V1 locked-midfoot Plant is not qualified.

decisions.locator: de Leva whole-foot mass fraction 0.0137 x 79 kg, split 43.2/42.4/14.4 % per S02
decisions.notes: Sum equals the de Leva whole-foot mass.

decisions.statement: MTP nominal axis location and toe length.
decisions.locator: first-MTP fulcrum locations span ~70-79% of foot length in published data
decisions.sensitivity: MTP location sensitivity [0.70, 0.79] x foot length
decisions.notes: 0.75 is a reduced-axis nominal, not subject-specific anatomy.

decisions.statement: Plantar contact regions and dimensions (heel / forefoot / toe).
decisions.locator: reduced contact patches matching the frozen foot partition; heel breadth is materially below ball breadth (S18)
decisions.sensitivity: patch dimension sensitivity +/- 0.010 m; only these regions may create valid support
decisions.notes: The three regions are independently observable; RES-84 builds the support hull/CoP authority from their active contacts.

decisions.statement: Foot frame, joint centers and segment partition.
decisions.locator: S02 joint-chain proximal conventions applied to the frozen reduced geometry
decisions.sensitivity: midtarsal placement sensitivity +/- 0.010 m; segment-inertia sensitivity 0.5x/1.5x
decisions.notes: Assembled foot COM cross-check against the de Leva whole-foot COM is declared in AB-15.

decisions.locator: S02 Table 3 relative tensors scaled by m^(5/3)
decisions.notes: Diagonal terms used with a declared axis mapping; off-diagonal products are not silently imported into the sagittal model.

decisions.locator: predictive gait-model prior; not a CMJ measurement
decisions.sensitivity: k set [0, 12.5, 25, 40]; c set [0, 0.4, 2]; zero-passive case (k=0,c=0)
decisions.notes: Passive values are engineering priors only; material dependence reopens authority.

decisions.value: one bounded net plantarflexor/resistive moment per foot in parallel with the passive baseline; reduced net moment, not a literal single-muscle actuator; no hidden high-power toe motor or arbitrary flight-energy injection
decisions.locator: MTP restriction reduces CMJ height/impulse; intrinsic foot muscle activity drives MTP stiffness; the actuator channel is a reduced design decision informed by that evidence
decisions.sensitivity: final torque/rate/power caps owned by RES-85; supported-phase saturation telemetry mandatory
decisions.notes: A passive-only MTP is NOT sufficient as the sole mechanism for a human-valid maximal-CMJ claim.

decisions.value: qualification must report passive MTP work, active MTP work, total MTP work/power and an active-vs-passive sensitivity, proving no double-counting of distal power and no hidden toe-energy source
decisions.sensitivity: active-vs-passive separation required in every qualification report
decisions.notes: Separation must be demonstrated, not asserted.

value.rule: no collision geom may extend below the sole plane, and all three contact patches are planar on the sole plane

decisions.locator: locked-midfoot reduced geometry; all three contact patches are planar on the sole plane
decisions.notes: The foot's visual/collision body above the sole is a RES-83 implementation detail, but no collision geom may protrude below the sole plane, and only the frozen patches may create valid support.

decisions.value: ankle x +/- 0.010 m; MTP location span 0.70-0.79 L; foot length +/- 0.010 m; midfoot alternative; segment inertia 0.5x/1.5x
decisions.notes: No sensitivity may be silently omitted from the qualification manifest.
